name: ashray-akruti-classroom-sync
description: Teacher-student synchronised classroom platform for existing Ashray Akruti resources

scripts.setup: node -e "require('fs').existsSync('.env')||require('fs').copyFileSync('.env.example','.env')" && npm install && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c teal,blue "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
